title: Morne-Brume
description: The Morne-Brume server Modpack. This Modpack contains all the mods needed to play on the Morne-Brume French RP Server.
body:
# Morne-Brume Modpack

Morne-Brume Modpack contains all the Mods necessary to play on the Morne-Brume French Roleplay Server. It's mostly based on the Conquest mod and resource pack but with many more mods to make the game more friendly for textual roleplay.

## Requirements

This modpack is made to be used on the Morne-Brume Roleplay Server. There is more mods necessary to play on the server. They can be downloaded here:
- [VictoryMod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/victorymod/download/5233496)
